package sg.gov.agency.cpf.claims.web;

import java.util.List;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import sg.gov.agency.cpf.claims.service.ClaimQueryService;
import sg.gov.agency.cpf.claims.web.dto.ClaimView;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/claims")
public class ClaimController {

    private final ClaimQueryService claimQueryService;

    public ClaimController(final ClaimQueryService claimQueryService) {
        this.claimQueryService = claimQueryService;
    }

    @GetMapping("/{claimId}")
    public ResponseEntity<ClaimView> byId(@PathVariable final String claimId) {
        return claimQueryService.find(claimId)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
    }

    @GetMapping("/member/{nric}")
    public List<ClaimView> byMember(@PathVariable("nric") final String maskedNric) {
        return claimQueryService.findByMember(maskedNric);
    }
}
